title.en: The Path of a Single Breath

text.zh: 此刻你正在吸气。这口空气从鼻孔到血液，全程不到一秒，沿途要过好几道门。
text.en: You are breathing in right now. This mouthful of air reaches your blood in under a second, passing through several gates on the way.

text.zh: 第一道门是喉。空气从这里进去时，会厌像盖子一样翻开；吞咽时它又立刻盖住。
text.en: The first gate is the larynx. As air passes through, the epiglottis flips open like a lid — and snaps shut the moment you swallow.

text.zh: 往下是气管，一根被软骨环撑着的硬管子。躺着、低头、被人掐住，它都不会塌。
text.en: Below runs the trachea, a tube held open by cartilage rings. Lie down, bow your head, take a chokehold — it will not collapse.

text.zh: 到胸腔正中，气管一分为二，然后不停地分。这棵倒着长的树，每一级都比上一级细一点、多一倍。
text.en: In mid-chest the airway forks in two, then keeps forking. This upside-down tree halves its width and doubles its count at every level.

text.zh: 右肺三叶，是这口气的主要去处。空气走到最细的末梢，一层薄膜之隔就是血。
text.en: The right lung, with its three lobes, takes most of this breath. At the finest twigs, only one thin membrane separates air from blood.

text.zh: 但肺自己动不了。真正把这口气吸进来的，是下面这块穹顶形的膈肌——它一压平，胸腔就变大。
text.en: Yet the lungs cannot move themselves. The real work is done below, by the dome-shaped diaphragm: it flattens, and the chest cavity grows.

text.zh: 肋间肌同时把肋骨一根根提起来，胸廓像手风琴一样张开。深呼吸时，你摸得到它们在动。
text.en: At the same time the intercostals lift the ribs one by one, opening the chest like an accordion. Breathe deeply and you can feel them working.

text.zh: 然后膈肌一松，一切反向来一遍，这口气就还回去了。一天大约两万次，你几乎从不留意。
text.en: Then the diaphragm relaxes, the whole sequence runs backwards, and the breath is given back — about twenty thousand times a day, almost never noticed.
